title: "What’s Up, Doc?": Analyzing How Users Seek Health Information in Large-Scale Conversational AI Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on the curation and analysis of a dataset for health-related user-AI interactions. While the filtering process identifies and removes religious hate speech to maintain a healthcare focus, and the analysis notes minor user queries regarding the ethics of AI in medicine, the work does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks.
